subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The session began in the aftermath of the intense battle in Hommlet

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Zinnia's stabilization roll
fact: Zinnia successfully stabilized, rolling a 16 on her save, securing her survival.
source_quote: rolling a 16 on her save

subject: Calmer's killing blow
fact: Calmer, for the second time this session, struck the killing blow using his Spiritual Weapon, dispatching Rannos (who was down to 2 hit points) with a dramatic flourish.
source_quote: for the second time this session, struck the killing blow

subject: Cure Light Wounds healing
fact: Calmer cast Cure Light Wounds, healing her for 24 points.
source_quote: healing her for 24 points

subject: Deep Temple
fact: The Deep Temple (the overarching leadership of the Temple of Elemental Evil) was identified as the faction behind Rannos and Gremag.
source_quote: agents of the Deep Temple

subject: Thorne's cleanup retainer
fact: Thorne (the Duke) offered his services on a retainer basis (20 gold pieces per month plus 100 gold pieces per incident).
source_quote: 20 gold pieces per month plus 100 gold pieces per incident

subject: Thorne's payment
fact: The party agreed to pay him 100 gold pieces for this first cleanup.
source_quote: pay him 100 gold pieces for this first cleanup

subject: Elmo's true identity
fact: Zinnia's high Insight roll (a natural 20) confirmed Elmo was feigning inebriation and working for Verbobonc.
source_quote: Zinnia's high Insight roll (a natural 20) confirmed

subject: Elmo's task
fact: Elmo urged the party to return to the Moathouse immediately to investigate what's going on and destroy whatever evil presence is there.
source_quote: investigate what's going on and destroy whatever evil presence is there

subject: Kron Hills
fact: Verbobonc could not send troops without risking conflict with the gnomes of the Kron Hills.
source_quote: gnomes of the Kron Hills

subject: Lareth's suspicion
fact: Lareth rolled a high check and saw through the party's deception, furious that they had failed his mission and were now attempting to backstab him.
source_quote: Lareth rolled a high check and saw through their deception

subject: Zephyr's mockery
fact: Zephyr mocked Lareth: 'The only person here that's backstabbing is you.'
source_quote: 'The only person here that's backstabbing is you.'

subject: combat initiation
fact: The session concluded just as the fight with Lareth and his guards was about to begin.
